CLI litert-lm run --no-template --temperature 0 --seed 42 works but has no max-new-tokens flag; for exact 32-token caps use the Python API. Synchronous session.run_decode() fails on this bundle - use run_decode_async(). One engine+session PER FIXTURE: sequential sessions in one process exhaust the engine state pool. Engine writes <bundle>_<size>.xnnpack_cache beside the bundle - redirect via Engine(cache_dir=...) near manifest-controlled stages.
